name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessible kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for an accessible kitchen remodel, look for a company with experience in universal design principles and a strong understanding of accessibility standards. Verify their licensing and insurance. Review their portfolio of past accessible projects and check client testimonials or references. A good contractor will listen to your specific needs, offer practical solutions, and communicate clearly throughout the project. City Dweller, LLC specializes in accessible home modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in universal design, proper licensing, and positive client references, like City Dweller, LLC.
